units.source: Vertical and horizontal layout
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout

units.source: Trilium supports two different layouts, based on your preference.
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout

units.source: Vertical layout__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Vertical layout

units.source: The vertical layout is Trilium's original layout:
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Vertical layout

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is positioned on the left side of the screen, with buttons being laid out vertically.
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Vertical layout

units.source: The tab bar is at the top, but to the right of the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Vertical layout

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Quick search__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is at the top of the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Vertical layout

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__ can be collapsed by pressing the __TRILIUM_PH_2__ button at the bottom of the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_4__. While collapsed, it can be peeked temporarily above the content by pressing the strip on the right side of the __TRILIUM_PH_5__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_6__.
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Vertical layout

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ can be accessed via the __TRILIUM_PH_2__ icon at the top of the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_4__.
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Vertical layout

units.source: Horizontal layout__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Horizontal layout

units.source: The horizontal layout is a more traditional layout, since it bears similarity with other applications. In this mode:
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Horizontal layout

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is at the top of the screen, with the buttons laid horizontally.
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Horizontal layout

units.source: The tab bar is at the top of the screen, but now covers the entirety of the width, allowing for more tabs to be displayed at once.
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Horizontal layout

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Quick search__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is now part of the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_3__. It can be moved around according to preference and even removed if needed.
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Horizontal layout

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__ can be collapsed by pressing the small __TRILIUM_PH_2__ button to the left of the first tab. While collapsed, it can be peeked temporarily above the content by pressing the strip on the left edge of the app.
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Horizontal layout

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ can be accessed via the __TRILIUM_PH_2__ button at the end of the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_4__.
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Horizontal layout

units.source: Changing the layout__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Changing the layout

units.source: Go to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and look for the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Appearance__TRILIUM_PH_3__ option on the left. Then look for the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Layout__TRILIUM_PH_5__ section, where there is the possibility to switch between the two available layouts.
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Changing the layout

units.source: Clicking an option will immediately apply the selected layout by reloading the window.
units.context: Vertical and horizontal layout > Changing the layout
